[agent-drafted: Atlas (session-<uuid>) -> Atlas: Sweep Compute Survey (session-<uuid>)]

From now on you report directly to `HUMAN`; his messages are your instructions. You are a detached Report of Atlas: you sit under it in the thread list, but you send it nothing and it does not instruct you. If `HUMAN` attaches you, Atlas will say so in one message that names where your updates go; from then on you are its Report. Your task, scope, rules and own Reports are unchanged, and you archive nothing without his say.
